about: Stone, both stromatolites, the twelve plants and cliff-gleba on a REAL Gleba surface with every control at its default except gleba_enemy_base at size 0, otherwise as the graded arm. Each entity is [name index, x * 256, y * 256], and each cliff carries a fourth element, an index into orientations (LuaEntity.cliff_orientation); an entity is listed when floor(position) is in the window or within RING tiles of it (3: a cliff box reaches two tiles past its position). cliffSettings is surface.map_gen_settings.cliff_settings read back. Fields are calculate_tile_properties at positions (512 overall, then 256 where gleba_rockpools is above 0), as f32 hex bits. Written by FMW_ARM=cliffs scripts/probes/gleba-entities/capture.ts.
